notes.title: Game Released!
notes.content:
[h2]I am pleased to announce that the first video game I developed four years ago is finally being released on Steam![/h2]

This visual novel was created right after I played the 1st Ace attorney game and two danganronpa games. 

As it was going to be my first game to develop I decided to make it a visual novel so I didn't have to complicate my life programming mechanics...

Although in the end I did have to program mechanics, like the minigames he he...

[i]Enjoy the game and its references![/i]
